race.description: Asahi Super Dry Let's Elope Stakes (G2)
race.comment: GOLD COAST BELLE (4) is a progressive mare who resumed with a very sharp win, sitting close to a moderate tempo but sprinting right away from Tennessee Bound who has since run well in G3 company. She goes from a BM88 to a G2 here but in reality the jump isn't that high and plenty of mares have done that in recent years. Rolls forward and should continue to progress. COEUR VOLANTE (5) has been up a long time but is continuing to race well. This is a fair bit easier than the G2 PB Lawrence last time, her form prior with big weights was rock solid. SALTY PEARL (1) got home very well first up at Caulfield over 1200m in a lovely return. Up in trip suits, she does have to give away weight as a 4yo mare and probably gets back but look for her late. ON DISPLAY (8) didn't really fire last campaign but is better than that and sets up well for Lane.
